model_annotation: This donut chart visually represents the distribution of data across two nested categorical dimensions: “Ambiguity Std (Outer)” and “Max Ambiguity (Inner)”. The outer ring, segmented into four shades of blue, corresponds to standard deviation levels (Std: 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, 0.94), with respective proportions of 49.0%, 38.0%, 39.0%, and 14.2%. The inner ring, composed of three lighter blue shades, reflects maximum ambiguity levels (Max: 1, 2, 3), with proportions of 47.7%, 7.0%, and 5.0%. Percentages are labeled directly on each segment, and a dual legend on the right clarifies the color coding for both outer and inner ring categories. The chart effectively overlays two classification schemes to show how proportions are distributed across combinations of ambiguity standard deviation and maximum ambiguity values.
